segments: mmm-title
MMM Budget Optimizer. A skill for your coding agent.
It reads your weekly sales and ad spend, and shows where the next pound sells most.
mmm-pipeline
You hand your agent three years of weekly data.
The engine fits the model, checks it on weeks it never saw, and only then moves the budget.
mmm-fit
The fit takes twenty two milliseconds.
On the thirteen weeks it never saw, it misses actual sales by under one percent.
mmm-curves
Each channel gets a response curve.
The slope at today's spend is the marginal return. Search returns two point three per pound. Social returns one point two.
mmm-plan
The optimizer moves budget from social into search and TV, with the same total spend.
Every channel ends at a marginal return of one point nine two, so no pound has a better place to go.
Weekly sales from media rise by ninety five.
mmm-proof
We tested it on ten datasets with known answers.
On nine of them, the plan captured over ninety percent of the best possible gain. On one, sixty three percent.
mmm-cta
MMM Budget Optimizer is free on Agensi.
The engine is open source, at yabloko labs slash M M M engine.
